title: Knowledge CRUD completeness — delete with confirmation, rename fix, type-specific fields
description: Complete CRUD for CharacterTab, LocationTab, and PlotTab: add delete button with confirmation dialog, fix rename (currently creates duplicate due to MERGE behavior), add type-specific editable fields (Character: role/traits; Location: geography; Plot: chapter/act).
action: In PersistedEntityTab.tsx: (1) Add delete button next to save button, wired to graph-engine deleteEntity() via new buildGraphDeleteMutation() in knowledgeUtils.ts, with confirmation dialog. (2) Fix rename: when matchName !== draftName, execute MATCH+SET to update name on existing node first, then update other fields. (3) Add entity-type-specific field sections via a field config prop. Update CharacterTab, LocationTab, PlotTab to pass their field configs.

criteria: src/components/knowledge/PersistedEntityTab.tsx contains confirmation dialog logic before delete
src/components/knowledge/PersistedEntityTab.tsx handles name change (rename) without creating duplicates
CharacterTab passes type-specific fields (role, traits) to PersistedEntityTab
LocationTab passes type-specific fields (geography) to PersistedEntityTab
PlotTab passes type-specific fields (chapter, act) to PersistedEntityTab
convergence.verification: Create a character, rename it, verify old name is gone. Delete with confirmation, verify entity removed from list. Edit type-specific fields, save, reload, verify persisted.
convergence.definition_of_done: Character/Location/Plot entries support full CRUD: create, rename, update all fields, delete with confirmation. No stale duplicates after rename.

files.change: Add delete button with confirmation dialog. Fix rename: when matchName !== draftName, execute MATCH (n:Type {name: matchName, workspaceId}) SET n.name = draftName first. Add optional `extraFields` prop: Array<{key: string, label: string, type: 'text'|'textarea'}> rendered as additional form fields in editor, persisted to entity properties JSON.
Add extraFields prop: [{key:'role', label:'Role', type:'text'}, {key:'traits', label:'Traits', type:'textarea'}]
Add extraFields prop: [{key:'chapter', label:'Chapter', type:'text'}, {key:'act', label:'Act', type:'text'}]
Add FieldConfig interface: {key: string, label: string, type: 'text' | 'textarea'}. Add extraFields?: FieldConfig[] to PersistedEntityTab props type.

implementation: In KnowledgeTypes.ts: Add `export interface FieldConfig { key: string; label: string; type: 'text' | 'textarea' }`

In PersistedEntityTab.tsx: Accept `extraFields?: FieldConfig[]` prop. In the editor section, after the description textarea, render extraFields as labeled inputs/textareas, reading values from selectedItem properties and writing back on save.

In PersistedEntityTab.tsx: Add delete button (Trash2 icon) next to save button, only shown when matchName is set (editing existing). On click, show confirmation: `Are you sure you want to delete "{matchName}"?`. On confirm, call buildGraphDeleteMutation(entityType, matchName, matchWorkspaceId) then executeCypher, then clear editor and reload items.

In PersistedEntityTab.tsx: Fix rename in save handler — before the main MERGE, if matchName !== draftName, execute: `MATCH (n:${entityType} {name: $oldName, workspaceId: $wid}) SET n.name = $newName RETURN n` with oldName=matchName, newName=draftName. Then proceed with normal MERGE using the updated name.
In knowledgeUtils.ts (or inline): Add buildGraphDeleteMutation(entityType, name, workspaceId) returning `MATCH (n:${entityType} {name: $name, workspaceId: $workspaceId}) DETACH DELETE n`
Update CharacterTab, LocationTab, PlotTab to pass extraFields arrays

reference.pattern: PersistedEntityTab uses buildGraphMergeMutation() from knowledgeUtils.ts — delete mutation follows same pattern

rationale.chosen_approach: Extend PersistedEntityTab with extraFields prop rather than creating type-specific tab components — all three tabs remain thin wrappers
decision_factors: Extra fields stored in existing properties JSON — no schema changes
graph-engine deleteEntity() already cascades to relations
rationale.tradeoffs: Field configs are client-side only — backend doesn't enforce field schemas. Acceptable for M1.
